items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Like Buddy Rich? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, something like that. But Buddy's a Musician.

ctx.x: So he said, "Butler, I can't hire you never no more." I said, yes, but man, I come from New York. I didn't come from no island, no where. I come from the magic isle. Now, you know I'm going to find out what you're doing. (Unintelligible). Now, this here's how he starts the band, one, two, one, two, three, four, that's how you start the band. He says, "All right, let's go." And he would have the bongo beating on the -- let's go fellows, let's go. Whomp, whomp, whomp, whomp. So I saw that, and he's out in front of…
Yeah, something like that. But Buddy's a Musician.
